body:
I would probably not consider this to fix #105987, since it doesn't actually resolve the discrepancy between the two engines. #106018 is likely the only real fix, since the way Godot Physics calculates damping seems somewhat questionable. However, with that being a breaking change I'm not sure it'll ever be merged at this point, especially considering Godot Physics 3D will likely be phased out in a not too distant future.

Anyway, that doesn't mean we can't merge this change. However, I would probably say we should use an `or_greater` property hint instead, rather than just setting the maximum value to some arbitrary number. With that the slider will still be between 0 and 1 (for now) but you should still be able to manually type in values higher than 1.

You can see an example of `or_greater` being used with the `shrinking_factor` property just a few lines above.

You'll want to also revert your change to `godot_soft_body_3d.h` in that case.
